question: What may the lamp garland be in the eight-eight rite?
premises: The rite is manifold in names.
This rite is prescribed in many ways.
Its number may be a lamp garland.
inference: The lamp garland may represent the prescribed number.
plain_english: In the eight-eight rite too, in the manifold-named rite, this rite is prescribed in many ways; its number may be a lamp garland.
